column1: # THE RAW 13-CLAUSE FACTS FOR THE C1 CANDIDATE POPULATION.
# These are RAW FACTS: the eligibility verdict is NOT authored here.
# The canonical 13-clause checker and the independent PolyC verifier
# each COMPUTE the verdict from this table.  The schema is the
# canonical checker's own 20-field schema, so the table can be fed to
# the unmodified canonical tool without transformation.
# THE FACTS ARE RE-DERIVED FROM THE CURRENT SOURCE.  They are NOT
# copied from RECON07's table: RECON07's table still describes the
# PRE-SLICE08 candidate population, in which SUB-001, SUB-002 and
# SUB-003 were live legacy-C authorities and SUB-004 was the
# provisional leader.  After SLICE08, SUB-001, SUB-002 and SUB-003
# are ALREADY SELF-HOSTED, so their clause 02 bit is 0.
# The ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE_ROWS count of 10 is SUB-004 plus the nine
# scalars.  It is NOT an eligibility VERDICT: the verdict is computed
# by the canonical checker and by the independent PolyC verifier in C2,
# and both must agree with each other and with these raw facts.
